title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: surcharge uplift by declared class
content:
## Rule
For the hazardous-cargo surcharge written at loading under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the uplift of the declared class is 10 percent for class 4.1, 15 percent for class 8, 30 percent for division 5.2, 20 percent for division 6.1 and for division 2.1, 60 percent for division 2.3, 25 percent for divisions 4.2 and 4.3, 80 percent for class 7 and 0 for every other class — and 0 for every class under AHL DG Limited Quantity. The class and the category are those recorded on the acceptance.

## Class uplift by category
| Category | Class uplift (percent) |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 0 for every class (2.2, 3, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1, 8 and 9) |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | class 9: 0 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | class 3: 0; class 4.1: 10; class 8: 15 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | division 5.1: 0; division 5.2: 30; division 6.1: 20 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | division 2.1: 20; division 2.2: 0; division 2.3: 60 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | class 1.4S: 0; divisions 4.2 and 4.3: 25; class 7: 80 |

## Points of judgement
- *Class 4.1 goods accepted under AHL DG Limited Quantity — 10 percent?* No; every class under AHL DG Limited Quantity carries 0.
- *Class 4.1 goods under AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives?* 10 percent.
- *Division 6.1 under AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers?* 20 percent; the same figure applies to division 2.1 under AHL DG Compressed Gases.
